rows.quote: The summary data of GWAS can be downloaded from the FinnGen database (R9 release) at https://www.finngen.fi/en/access_results.
rows.coder_note: The sentence names the FinnGen database with its release, R9; no other identifier conflicts.
Both passages say only 'IPF GWAS data from UK Biobank'; reference 18 is a UK Biobank ethics web page with no DOI, PMID or PMC identifier; no release, accession, sample size or analysis is given.

rows.quote: In this population-based and prospective study, a total of 2004 significant proteins were identified in European American individuals.
rows.reference_quote: Zhang J Dutta D Köttgen A Tin A Schlosser P Grams ME Plasma proteome analyses in individuals of European and African ancestry identify cis-pQTLs and models for proteome-wide association studies Nat Genet 2022 54 5 593 602 10.1038/s41588-022-01051-w 35501419 PMC9236177
rows.coder_note: Rules E and F: the preceding sentence attributes the protein GWAS data to the ARIC study [17] (Zhang 2022, DOI 10.1038/s41588-022-01051-w), and the pinned adjacent sentence of the same description gives the ancestry, European American, which separates the two ARIC rows; no conflict in either passage.

rows.quote: The pQTLs were extracted from the deCODE study in which genome-wide association studies (GWASs) of 4907 plasma proteins were measured in 35,559 Icelanders by using SomaScan multiplex aptamer assay (version 4) [15].
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E Sulem P Atlason BA Sveinbjornsson G Magnusson MI Styrmisdottir EL Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease Nat Genet 2021 53 12 1712 21 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w 34857953
rows.coder_note: The sentence attributes the pQTLs to the deCODE study [15] (Ferkingstad 2021, DOI 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w, one dictionary row) and gives its exact N, 35,559 Icelanders, with SomaScan version 4 and 4907 proteins; no conflict.
